title: Draft the first inference experiment contract
question: How can we test one inference change fairly on an open model?
baseline: README.md, docs/stack.md, and docs/verification.md at the checked-out commit.
resources: A laptop, Python 3.11+, and access to public documentation. No GPU.
acceptance: Name one open baseline, its license, version selection method, and setup commands.
Define a fixed workload, quality floor, primary cost or latency metric, and minimum gain.
State hardware, repeat count, uncertainty method, and total budget.
Define an independent verification procedure and allowed regressions.
Mark all commands as proposed unless actually run. This task creates a draft contract.
checks: Manually review every cited primary source.
evidence: Time spent, tool used, and unresolved questions.
stop_conditions: No suitable licensed baseline found; report the gap.
deliverable: A draft experiment contract for review. No training or performance claim.
